about:
GD Process Design, LLC is based in Hartland, Wisconsin. The company was founded in 2008 by Lars K. Nielsen, beginning with a focus on service and spare-parts supply for the fats and oils industry before expanding into broader food processing applications.

The firm provides process design, engineering, project management, consulting, and after-sales service for food processing equipment. It engineers and supplies tempering units for product pre‑cooling, pre‑heating, pasteurization, and crystallization, and oversees equipment manufacturing, testing, delivery, installation, start‑up, commissioning, and operator training. Design work uses AutoCAD and SolidWorks for layout drawings, P&IDs, and equipment specifications. A comprehensive in‑stock parts inventory supports quick turnaround on wear and spare parts.

The company serves the food processing, fats and oils, dairy, and pharmaceutical industries. Customers include manufacturers producing butter, margarine, shortening, oils, confections, snack foods, and cryogenic freezing applications. GD Process Design partners with equipment builders such as Gerstenberg Services, Normit, FH Scandinox, FBF Italia, Dohmeyer, FASA, and Primo to supply scraped‑surface heat exchangers, pin‑rotor machines, high‑pressure homogenizers, piston pumps, and cryogenic freezers.

The company states its vision is to be the best in designing, supplying, and creating solutions for the fats, oils, and dairy sectors. Its mission emphasizes reliable, efficient support across engineering, project management, and after‑sales service, with a focus on flexibility and overseeing every project phase from design through installation.
